steps.text: The service is live with reset disabled. I have the native joint position controller and the robot’s state layout; I’m setting up a small command loop so each observation and motion stays on the same episode connection.

steps.code:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive controller for the PackDessert standard-mode episode.
+
+Run with: python /app/output/gen.py
+Send one JSON object per line on stdin. Supported operations:
+  {"op":"obs", "cameras":[...], "depth":true}
+  {"op":"submit", "actions":[[13 values], ...], "cameras":[...], "video":"none"}
+  {"op":"status"}
+
+The command loop keeps one Robot client connected and writes each returned frame
+and calibration under /app/output/ for visual inspection. It never resets.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print(json.dumps({"connected": True, "spec": spec, "status": r.status()}), flush=True)
+call_no = 0
+
+
+def save_result(res, prefix):
+    global call_no
+    call_no += 1
+    cams = {}
+    for cam, arr in res.last.items():
+        p = OUT / f"{prefix}_{call_no}_{cam}.png"
+        Image.fromarray(np.asarray(arr, dtype=np.uint8)).save(p)
+        cams[cam] = str(p)
+    if res.depth:
+        for cam, arr in res.depth.items():
+            p = OUT / f"{prefix}_{call_no}_{cam}_depth.npy"
+            np.save(p, arr)
+    meta = res.meta
+    result = {
+        "call": call_no,
+        "meta": meta,
+        "proprio": meta.get("proprio"),
+        "camera_calibration": meta.get("cameras"),
+        "images": cams,
+        "depth_cameras": list(res.depth),
+    }
+    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
+
+
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        req = json.loads(line)
+        op = req.get("op")
+        if op == "status":
+            print(json.dumps({"status": r.status()}), flush=True)
+        elif op == "obs":
+            res = r.get_obs(
+                cameras=req.get("cameras"),
+                seconds=float(req.get("seconds", 0.0)),
+                include_depth=bool(req.get("depth", False)),
+                video="none",
+            )
+            save_result(res, "obs")
+        elif op == "submit":
+            actions = np.asarray(req["actions"], dtype=np.float64)
+            res = r.submit(
+                "joint_position", actions,
+                dt=req.get("dt"),
+                interpolate=req.get("interpolate", "hold"),
+                cameras=req.get("cameras"),
+                video="none",
+                include_depth=bool(req.get("depth", False)),
+                note=req.get("note", "PackDessert manual controller"),
+            )
+            save_result(res, "submit")
+        else:
+            print(json.dumps({"error": f"unknown op: {op}"}), flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(e).__name__, "message": str(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
